summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ordinary share buyback transaction executed on 27 May 2026. The company purchased 5,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 101.8935 pence per share (high 102.35p, low 101.30p). These purchases are part of an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026; the shares will be cancelled. This is a routine open-market repurchase under an ongoing programme, not a special-situation tender offer, going-private, or capital-return event. No deal terms or special resolutions are involved. This is not a special situation; it is a routine current report on a buyback programme.
